> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **11** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 185512ccaf6394364a0da1af55cd8f1bfae37869` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

```sh

git fetch origin daf92bef44a17caea337e08698e19b7d269465d5 && git checkout daf92bef44a17caea337e08698e19b7d269465d5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 185512ccaf6394364a0da1af55cd8f1bfae37869 db2eb1e5967c3a7174db23dbe2b605d6bdbbbfd9 && git checkout -B drift-repro 185512ccaf6394364a0da1af55cd8f1bfae37869 && git merge --no-ff db2eb1e5967c3a7174db23dbe2b605d6bdbbbfd9
```

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than

> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 185512ccaf6394364a0da1af55cd8f1bfae37869` → pass the list as

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `db2eb1e5967c3a7174db23dbe2b605d6bdbbbfd9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.diff-missing-version.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.diff-canonical-type-and-history-outage.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-history-diff-authoring-door.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-draft-read-author-exemption.test.ts, scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json + packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts (the `/diff` and `/rollback` doors, read at the head), packages/rest/src/error-response.ts (`handleRouteError` / `resolveErrorResponse`, the envelope the throw rides), packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts (the package entry: `versionNotFoundError` is not on it), packages/metadata-protocol/package.json (one `.` export, no subpath), packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts (`VERSION_NOT_FOUND` already ledgered for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`), packages/client/src/index.ts (`diffItem` forwards `from`/`to` as given), ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts (`diff`, no caller in `ui/`), packages/rest/src/rest-server-query-number-reads.test.ts (the `from=0 → fromVersion: 0` forwarding pin, on a mocked protocol), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.diff-dead-history-read.test.ts and packages/objectql/src/protocol-publish-rollback.test.ts (every other explicit-version diff pin seeds its rows), scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs and scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs (ruling A level axis, the `(narrowing)` arm), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md line 106, content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx and content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx (the only docs naming `/diff`).

Read 2026-10-27T07:25Z: card #26462 body and all 3 comments (triage `6434115388`, claim `6434783381`, os-dev-report `6436042712`); PR #26540 body, its 8-file list, `git diff origin/main...db2eb1e5` (+429/−26); the check-runs on `db2eb1e5`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`diffMetaItem` accept set narrows: a named `fromVersion` / `toVersion` with no history row of `(type, name)` now throws instead of comparing an empty side — RIGHT.** `protocol.ts` 27363–27377 and 27422–27429 replace `byVersion.get(v) ?? null` with a `=== undefined` test and `throw versionNotFoundError({ type: singularType, name }, v)`. `byVersion` is built from `histRows`, which stores a delete tombstone as `body: null` (27451–27455), so `Map.get` answers `null` (served, compared as `{}`) for a tombstone and `undefined` only for a missing row. The tombstone control in `protocol.diff-missing-version.test.ts` pins that distinction. Both sides are checked in the order `to` then `from`, so "both missing" names `to` (999 in the card's step 4), which is the version the REST case asserts.
2. **The default range is never refused — RIGHT.** The `request.toVersion === undefined` branch (active-row read, 27378–27420) and the `request.fromVersion === undefined` walk (27430–27467) are untouched; an item with no history and no `from`/`to` still answers `{ fromVersion: null, toVersion: null, added: [], removed: [], changed: [] }` (pinned). The 503 outage path (`rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned`) is untouched; with an unprovisioned table `histRows` is `[]`, so the default range answers the benign empty diff and a named version is the 404 miss, which the docblock and the rewritten #8833 pin now say explicitly. Both benign answers remain distinct from the 503: ADR-0110 D3 holds on both sides.
3. **One refusal, not two — RIGHT.** `versionNotFoundError(ref, version)` in `sys-metadata-repository.ts` 544–554 builds `Error & { code: 'VERSION_NOT_FOUND'; status: 404 }` with the sentence `restoreVersion` built inline before (`No history row at version N for TYPE/NAME.`, byte-identical to the removed lines 1637–1644). `restoreVersion` line 1661 now throws it; its tombstone (`VERSION_NOT_RESTORABLE` 409) and bundled-member (`VERSION_NOT_FOUND` with the member sentence) arms are unchanged. The parity arm in the new test compares `{ code, status, message }` of the two doors on the same item and version.
4. **Public surface: no export added — RIGHT.** `versionNotFoundError` is a module export of `sys-metadata-repository.ts` imported by `protocol.ts` (line 60); `index.ts` 142–149 exports only `SysMetadataRepository`, `resetEnvWritableMetadataTypes` and five types from that module, and `package.json` has the single `.` entry. `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` is already in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (error-code-ledger.zod.ts 719); no error code, schema key, or `packages/spec` file is added or changed (the lane red line holds).
5. **The REST `/diff` door narrows with it, with no route edit — RIGHT.** `meta-item-history-routes.ts` 998–1004 forwards `fromVersion`/`toVersion` to `diffMetaItem` inside the handler's `try`, whose `catch` calls `handleRouteError(res, error)`; `resolveErrorResponse` passes a thrown 4xx `status` + `code` through (`error-response.ts` 366, 589–592), the same path the rollback door's step-7 404 rides. `readDeclaredQueryNumber` still forwards `from=0` as `fromVersion: 0` (query-number-reads pin 288, on a mocked protocol, so that pin is unaffected), and the protocol now refuses 0 as a version with no row: the changeset names `from=0` under "Who sees it". One nuance the changeset does not state and need not: for a type whose per-caller gate reads the current document and does not gate on its own key, a never-stored item is answered by `sendMetaItemAbsent` at 985–991 before the protocol is reached; that is pre-existing (it was not a 200 before either) and the card's `dashboard` and the test's `view` gate on their own key (#22639), so the card's step 6 reaches the new 404.
6. **The "other item's version" question — RIGHT, and answered by code, not only by test.** The history read is `where: { type, name }` (27441–27448) then `historyRowsOfMember`, so another item's rows are never in `byVersion`; on main the probe was the "everything removed" miss, now the 404. The new test seeds `other` v1–v3 with a `secret_marker` and asserts the message names `dashboard/qa_diff_probe` and not `other`.
7. **Pins whose asserted value moved — each keeps its subject, RIGHT.** (a) `protocol.diff-canonical-type-and-history-outage.test.ts` #8833 "genuinely-absent table": subject is "not the 503"; now asserts the default range's empty diff AND the named-version 404 under `MISSING_TABLE_ERROR`, a stronger pin. (b) Same file, #8868 `fieldz`: subject is "the boundary does not refuse a plugin-shaped spelling"; with no rows the named versions would be a 404 that reads like a refusal, so it now seeds two versions and asserts `REAL_DIFF_BODY`, which proves the served path rather than an empty answer. (c) The three REST builder controls that read a draft via `from=0` now diff from `v-1` (reading `navigation` as the `to` side of its `changed` entry) or use the default `from`; who reads the draft whole vs pruned is unchanged. `from=0` appears in no production caller: `packages/client` `diffItem` and the `ui` metadata client forward what they are given, and `ui/` has no caller of `diff`.
8. **New REST case on the real protocol — RIGHT.** Four 404 `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` arms (both missing, `to` missing, `from` missing, never-existed item) each assert the missing version in the text, with the step-3 control at 200 carrying `label` under `changed`.
9. **Stub-engine ledger — RIGHT.** `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains the three `(delete, findOne, update)` entries for the new test file, matching the `assertEngine*` calls in its stub; the stub's `find` applies `limit`, which `check:objectql-double-limit` requires. Both gates are in the derived list run green on the PR body; the `Lint · repo & tooling gates` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` check-runs are `success`.
10. **Every other explicit-version diff pin in the repo seeds its rows** (`protocol.diff-dead-history-read.test.ts` 255–285 `seedTwoVersions`, 340–354 `seedLineage` v1–v3; `objectql` `protocol-publish-rollback.test.ts` 338–354 saves two versions), so no sibling suite depends on the old empty-side answer. The one `?from=0&to=N` idiom lived only in the three REST controls this diff rewrote.

Nothing wrong found. One doc-precision note, not a defect: the changeset's "An item that never existed answered 200 'no change'" is the protocol door's answer and the REST door's for types gating on their own key (the card's case); it is not claimed for every type, and the "Now" and "Unchanged" lines are accurate as written.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/26462-diff-missing-version-refused.md`: `'@objectstack/metadata-protocol': patch`, title `fix(metadata-protocol)!: …`, `**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the ADR-0087 comment `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

- **Package set — RIGHT.** The only published source that moves is `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`protocol.ts`, `sys-metadata-repository.ts`). `@objectstack/rest` changes tests only; its door narrows through the dependency, and the changeset names that door. `check-empty-changeset` and both `Check Changeset` check-runs are `success`.
- **Level — RIGHT under ruling A.** `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 901–922: the level follows the `Metadata-protocol:` line alone; `none` ⇒ every introduced entry `patch`, and "a non-protocol … narrowing ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition". Nothing an author writes changes (no authorable-surface or defaults shard moves), so `none` is true and `patch` is the level the gate requires, not merely permits.
- **Clause-②: line — RIGHT.** The PR body and the changeset both carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: no surface is widened, a published accept set is narrowed, and `(narrowing)` is the arm `clause2-line.mjs` 113–116 defines for exactly this ("NOT a widening, but breaking"), the arm the ADR-0087 gate reads (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` 712) and the arm `record-recognisers` maps to this face. The `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition is correct: no stored row shape changes, nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite. `Metadata-protocol: none` beside a `(narrowing)` arm is not one of the gate's two contradictions.
- The narrowing is published honestly: the changeset's Before / Now / Unchanged / Who sees it / Remedy lines match the code read above, line for line.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured on this diff: `diffMetaItem`, and `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/diff` through it, refuse a named `from`/`to` version with no history row of the item with 404 `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` where they answered 200; nothing is widened, no export, error code or spec key is added.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Card "Not confirmed: whether a version from ANOTHER item's history leaks through" — answered, no.** Judgment 6 above: the read is keyed by `(type, name)`; the leak was never possible, the miss read as "everything removed", and it is now the 404, pinned.
- **Dev report `open_questions: []`** — nothing to answer.
- **Dev out-of-scope finding: execution-duties.md line 106 says a narrowing card is `Clause-②: no`, while the claim (`6434783381`) and the dev report said `yes (narrowing)` — answered, the head is right.** The claim's `yes (narrowing)` is the pre-ruling-A spelling; the head's `no (narrowing)` on both carriers agrees with execution-duties line 106, with `clause2-line.mjs`'s definition of the arm, with the changeset gate's reading (the arm, not the value, carries the breaking signal) and with the face this record is rendered on. The dev moved the line in `db2eb1e5` before the four changeset gates re-ran green. The process-text drift the dev noted (precedent changesets spelled `yes (narrowing)`) is real but is not this PR's; it stays noted, not escalated.
- **PR "Acceptance notes": `from=0` was a test idiom only** — confirmed by the caller grep in judgment 7; **step 6 probed as a `view`, not the card's `dashboard`** — accepted: both reach the same `diffMetaItem` lines and both gate on their own key at the REST door, and the protocol-level test uses `dashboard`.
- **Dev flag: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 locally (fixture commit unreachable in a shallow clone)** — CI owns it; `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` is `success` on this head.
- **File surface beyond the claim** (`sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`) — accepted: the first is the shared constructor the ruling asked to reuse rather than mint twice, the second is the ledger the stub-engine gate requires; neither is `packages/spec/**`.
